easyPrerequisites: Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing the legendary artifact, adding {R} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts or cast artifacts spells.
The artifact leaves the battlefield, triggering Yomiji, returning the artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the artifact by paying {R}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Slobad.
Repeat.
